assumptions.message: Defined role names as 'operator' and 'admin' corresponding to Greenhouse Operator and Greenhouse Admin.
Modeled environmental telemetry metrics (temperature, humidity, CO2, soil moisture) directly on the SensorReading entity.
PestDetection status initial state is UNREVIEWED, transitioning to REVIEWED, and then CONFIRMED or DISMISSED based on operator review.
Device status initial state is NORMAL, transitioning to FLAGGED when offline or on low battery, and REBOOTING upon admin command.
Configured light technical theme with #2e7d32 green accent matching 'clean and technical, light background, a leaf green accent'.
Design direction: Weather App (Hero-Centric Design); palette Atmospheric gradients (sky blue → sunset → storm grey) + temp scale; fonts Spatial Clear (Inter / Inter); from ui-ux-pro-max@28b3b8dee8c9
